monday.evidence: First sentence: 'It is Monday morning, and the demo that impressed everyone last quarter still has not become a rollout, because the compliance review keeps sending your AI feature back...'

regulated.evidence: 'We have shipped AI in regulated industries, including health and financial services, for organisations we do not name' - claim made in Crox's own 'we' voice; no client is named.

voice_we.evidence: 'We have shipped...', 'so we know...', 'we help your team...'; no 'I' and no third-person self-reference.

no_hype.evidence: No revolutionary, unlock, supercharge, game-changing, cutting-edge or similar hype words; plain wording such as 'approved, reliable'.

no_testimonial.evidence: No quotation or third-party endorsement; only the writer's own first-person claims.
